answer: Just as a falcon scans a drought-plagued plantation for weak stalks, multi-factor cryptographic proof-of-stake validates each autonomous node. Deploying this consensus protocol across a digital grove forces attackers to lock up massive capital and computational resources for every single clone. Relying on this math instead of any comforting fable means that spamming millions of fake bot identities becomes financially ruinous, though a deep-pocketed adversary might still brute-force poorly secured edge wallets.
